keyEvents.text: First Half begins.
Delay in match because of an injury Moisés Caicedo (Chelsea).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Delay in match because of an injury Moisés Caicedo (Chelsea).
Substitution, Chelsea. Jordan Henderson replaces Moisés Caicedo because of an injury.
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Goal! Chelsea 1, Leeds United 0. Emmanuel Emegha (Chelsea) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Morgan Rogers.
Goal! Chelsea 1, Leeds United 1. Noah Okafor (Leeds United) left footed shot from the left side of the box to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Dominic Calvert-Lewin.
Delay in match (Chelsea).
Delay in match (Leeds United).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Gabriel Gudmundsson (Leeds United) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
First Half ends, Chelsea 1, Leeds United 1.
Roméo Lavia (Chelsea) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Chelsea 1, Leeds United 2. Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Leeds United) converts the penalty with a right footed shot to the bottom right corner.
Goal! Chelsea 1, Leeds United 3. Noah Okafor (Leeds United) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the top left corner.
Substitution, Chelsea. Pedro Neto replaces Estêvão.
Substitution, Chelsea. Danny Welbeck replaces Emmanuel Emegha.
Jayden Bogle (Leeds United) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Leeds United. Brenden Aaronson replaces Noah Okafor.
Substitution, Chelsea. Geovany Quenda replaces Pep Chavarría.
Substitution, Chelsea. Malo Gusto replaces Josh Acheampong.
Sean Longstaff (Leeds United) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Leeds United. Anton Stach replaces Jayden Bogle.
Substitution, Leeds United. Joe Rodon replaces Ao Tanaka.
Substitution, Leeds United. Harry Wilson replaces Sean Longstaff.
Substitution, Leeds United. Melvin Bard replaces Gabriel Gudmundsson.
Goal! Chelsea 1, Leeds United 4. Brenden Aaronson (Leeds United) left footed shot from a difficult angle on the right to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Harry Wilson following a fast break.
Second Half ends, Chelsea 1, Leeds United 4.
